english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a person's physical ability to see.

exampleSentences.jyutping: si6 lik6 m4 hai6 gei2 hou2

english.note: Use this for the physical ability to see, rather than an aspiration or supernatural experience.

exampleSentences.english: My vision is still very good.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 ge3 si6 lik6 zung6 hou2 hou2

english.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for a person's ability to see, including in phrases such as good or poor eyesight.

exampleSentences.english: My eyesight has gotten much worse lately.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 gan6 paai4 si6 lik6 caa1 zo2 hou2 do1
